description: This module provides functions for handling EPUB files, including extracting cover images, embedding metadata, processing embedded images, and determining if an EPUB is fixed layout. It also registers a container processor for EPUB files within the iscc_sdk framework.

methods.name: epub_thumbnail
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail image from the EPUB cover image, resizing and enhancing sharpness.

methods.name: epub_meta_embed
methods.description: Embeds metadata into a copy of the EPUB file and returns the path to the new file.

methods.name: epub_cover
methods.description: Extracts the cover image bytes from an EPUB file by locating the cover image via metadata or manifest.

methods.name: epub_process_container
methods.description: Processes an EPUB file to extract embedded images and generate ISCC metadata, skipping fixed layout EPUBs.

methods.name: epub_extract_images
methods.description: Extracts images from an EPUB archive that meet minimum size criteria.

methods.name: is_fixed_layout_epub
methods.description: Determines if an EPUB file is fixed layout based on metadata indicators.
